svg.title: Forward guidance: a promised shift of the rule in quarter 8 moves today
svg.desc: A: the rule stays on and its intercept is 1 percentage point a year lower in quarter 8 only; today the output gap is -0.05 % and inflation 0.142. B: today's response for the same shift promised 0 to 12 quarters ahead; inflation today peaks for quarter 3. C, the forward guidance puzzle: with the nominal rate held still until the promised quarter, today's response relative to a cut made today grows with the horizon. Educational demos made to show an open-source tool. Not research.

g.text: Three-equation New Keynesian model, quarterly, calibration as in Galí (2015), ch. 3. Pure simulation, no data.

text.style: fill: #8b949e; font: 9.5px 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; text-anchor: start

g.text: Educational demos made to show an open-source tool. Not research. Woodford (2003); Clarida, Galí and Gertler (1999); Galí (2015).

text.style: fill: #8b949e; font: 10px 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; text-anchor: start

g.text: Full rational expectations, perfect foresight after the announcement. C is relative to quarter 0 (ratios, log scale), not a level.
